Aatrox has triumphed and is now one step closer to bringing about total destruction.

“No! The light... It cannot dim…”

Kill Kayle or Morgana twice before they can do the same to Aatrox.

“The end is coming. I shall deliver this world unto darkness... Oblivion!”

Kindred has ushered Tryndamere into the next realm, earning a bonus stack of their Passive Ability, Mark of the Kindred.

Lamb: “He still had much to live for...“
Wolf: “Those are the ones who give the best chase, little Lamb.”

Aatrox has triumphed and is now one step closer to bringing about total destruction.

Kayle: “We've failed them all...”
Morgana: “Together...”

On Aatrox's path to bring about the end of all things, there is no one and nothing that can stand in his way. His Ultimate Ability, World Ender, now lasts 3 seconds longer during which Aatrox becomes visually larger.

“I am doom!”

mLocKeys.keySummary: Passively, Aatrox heals when damaging enemy champions. On activation, he dashes in a direction.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Aatrox heals for @TotalEVamp@ of the damage he deals to Champions.

Active: Aatrox dashes. He can use this Ability while winding up his other Abilities.

mBuff.mDescription: Aatrox deals bonus damage on his next attack, healing for the damage dealt.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Periodically, Aatrox's next basic attack deals bonus <magicDamage>magic damage</magicDamage> and heals him, based on the target's max health.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Aatrox's Attacks deal an additional @PDamage@ max Health magic damage and restore @PHealingRatio*100@% of damage dealt as Health, reduced to @PHealingMinionMod*100@% against minions. This effect has a @PCooldown@ second cooldown.

Attack and Ability hits against champions and large jungle monsters reduce this effect's cooldown by 2 seconds. Hits with the edge of The Darkin Blade reduce it by 4 seconds instead.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{Passive_AatroxPassive_Tooltip}}

Deals a max of @MonsterDamageCap@ against monsters.
Multi-hits with Abilities only reduce the cooldown once.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Deathbringer Stance - Mutilator</titleLeft><mainText>Healing and shielding on this champion is reduced.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Deathbringer Stance</titleLeft><mainText>Aatrox's next basic attack will deal bonus damage and heal him.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Aatrox slams his greatsword down, dealing physical damage. He can swing three times, each with a different area of effect.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Aatrox slams his greatsword, dealing <physicalDamage>@QDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage>. If they are hit on the edge, they are briefly <status>Knocked Up</status> and they take <physicalDamage>@QEdgeDamage@</physicalDamage> instead. This Ability can be <recast>Recast</recast> twice, each one changing shape and dealing 25% more damage than the previous one.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Deals @QMinionDamage@ damage to minions.
Knock Up duration against monsters is doubled and it deals @QMonsterBonus@ bonus damage.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>World Ender</titleLeft><mainText>Aatrox has increased Move Speed, Attack Damage, and increased healing. If he gets a takedown, this effect is extended.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Aatrox unleashes his demonic form, fearing nearby enemy minions and gaining attack damage, increased healing, and Move Speed. If he gets a takedown, this effect is extended.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Aatrox reveals his true demonic form, Fearing nearby minions for @RMinionFearDuration@ seconds and gaining @RMovementSpeedBonus*100@% Move Speed decaying over @RDuration@ seconds. He also gains @RTotalADAmp*100@% Attack Damage and increases self-healing by @RHealingAmp*100@% for the duration.

Champion takedowns extend the duration of this effect by @RExtension@ seconds and refresh the Move Speed effect.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Deathbringer Stance</titleLeft><mainText>Aatrox's next basic attack will deal bonus damage and heal him.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Infernal Chains</titleLeft><mainText>This unit needs to leave the area or will get pulled back to the center.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Aatrox smashes the ground, dealing damage to the first enemy hit. Champions and large monsters have to leave the impact area quickly or they will be dragged to the center and take the damage again.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Aatrox fires a chain, <status>Slowing</status> the first enemy hit by @WSlowPercentage*-100@% for @WSlowDuration@ seconds and dealing <physicalDamage>@WDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage>. Champions and large jungle monsters have @WSlowDuration@ seconds to leave the impact area or be <status>Pulled</status> back to the center and damaged again for the same amount.
